record.name: Lark (Larksuite)
record.one_liner: An enterprise collaboration and communication suite with robust open APIs.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up on the Lark Developer platform and obtain credentials for free.
record.api_note: Extensive API coverage for messaging, docs, calendar, contacts, drive, and more.
